purpose: One-time simulation-only input stock for all 197 core countries, computed from their 21-type factory allocation and canonical production requirements.

quantityBasis.cycleTimePolicy: cycleDays is a completion delay and is not multiplied into one-cycle stock.

model.defaultRecipePolicy: Single-route types use their default route. Multi-route types split the starting factory-unit count over all canonical routes, prioritising the default route for any remainder; alternatives are never double-counted.
model.universalProcessorPolicy: Split universal processor capacity over commercial mine resource groups by site-count weight. Countries without a domestic site receive coal/iron-ore as simulated opening import stock.
model.externalInputsPolicy: Agricultural/external recipe inputs are one-time simulated opening stock. No import contracts, transactions or automatic replenishment are created.
model.reservePolicy: Geological reserves are never used as inventory.
model.stockPolicy: Every row becomes a separately tracked startup batch in the correct warehouse and is added without overwriting existing inventory.
